a: Athanasius yali omulabirizi w'e Alexandria okumala emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano, era kkumi na musanvu ku gyo yagimala mu buwaŋŋanguse, ng'agobebwa mu kibuga kye emirundi etaano abafuzi bana ab'enjawulo. Yali mumpi, addugavu era muwuuvu, era ab'omu lubiri lwa kabaka abaamulwanyisa okumala ebiseera ebisinga obulamu bwe baamuvunaana okutta, obulogo, obulyi bwa lukwe, okuvvoola ebitukuvu, era n'okutaataaganya emmere ey'empeke — era buli musango ku gyo gwagwa. Ekyo kye yagaana okukola kwe kuteeka omukono ku kiwandiiko kye yakkiriza nti kya bulimba, era okugaana okwo, okwakuumibwa okumala ekitundu ky'ekyasa, kye kisinga okuviirako ekkanisa okukyayatula nti Yesu Kristo ye Katonda.

q: Ekibuuzo ekyali e Nicaea kyali ki?
a: Omupriisita w'e Alexandria ayitibwa Arius yayigiriza nti Omwana, wadde nga ye asinga obukulu mu bitonde byonna era nga ye yayitibwamu okutonda, naye yali kitonde: "waaliwo ekiseera bwe yali tannabaawo." Kyali kisikiriza — kyakuuma Katonda nga simple era kyayinza okujuliza Ebyawandiikibwa — naye Athanasius yalaba omuwendo gwakyo: singa Omwana kitonde, kale ekyo ekyajja mu nsi mu Yesu Kristo tekyali Katonda wabula kyali kintu ekisinga obulungi mu ebyo Katonda bye yakola, era essuubi lyonna ery'Ekikristaayo ligwa ne lifuuka lugambo bugambo. Yagenda mu lukiiko olw'e Nicaea mu 325 ng'omudiikoni omuvubuka atalina ddoboozi.

Mu katabo katono ke yawandiika ng'akyali muvubuka, Athanasius yateeka enkyukakyuka endala mu lunyiriri lumu ekkanisa ey'Oluyonaani lw'etalekeranga kujuliza: "Kubanga Ye yafuuka omuntu, ffe tulyoke tufuulibwe ba Katonda." Tagamba nti abantu bafuuka bakatonda; ky'agamba kwe kuti Katonda akkiridde okukka wansi ekkubo lyonna, n'atwala omubiri ogw'amazima, n'afa okufa okw'amazima, era mu kukola ekyo n'asobozesa ebitonde okugabana ku bulamu bwa Katonda. Ebirala byonna ebiri mu ye biva mu sentensi eyo, nga mw'otwalidde n'emitawaana gyonna.

Yafuuka omulabirizi mu 328, era mu myaka musanvu yali agobeddwa okugenda e Trier; obuwaŋŋanguse obw'okubiri bwamusindika e Rome. Obw'okusatu bwatandika ku kiro ekimu mu Febwaali 356 abaserikale bwe beetooloola ekkanisa mu kusaba okw'ekiro: yatuula ku ntebe ye, n'alagira omudiikoni okutandika Zabbuli 136 — "kubanga okusaasira kwe kubeerera emirembe gyonna" — era n'agaana okuvaawo okutuusa ng'ekibiina kiwonye, n'oluvannyuma n'atwalibwa ng'ali kumpi okuzirika. Obuwaŋŋanguse obulala bubiri bwaddirira wansi wa Julian ne wansi wa Valens.

Gye yagenda kwali mu ddungu. Abamonaki b'e Misiri, abaali baayagala obulamu bwabwe era omutandisi waabwe gwe yali amanyi, ne bakweka omusajja asinga okunoonyezebwa mu bwakabaka mu bisenge, mu mpuku ne mu bifo eby'amazzi eby'omu kiwonvu kya Kiyira, era tewali n'omu eyamulyamu olukwe. Kyayamba nti yakulira ng'amanyi Olukoputi awamu n'Oluyonaani, bw'atyo ebyalo by'e Misiri ne bisobola okumukweka; waliwo enjogera ekyagenda mu maaso egamba nti mu buwaŋŋanguse bwe obw'enkomerero yeekweka emyezi ena mu ntaana ya kitaawe.

Mu myaka egy'okwekweka mwe mwava ekitabo ekisinga byonna okusomebwa kye yawandiika: ebyafaayo by'omusajja omukadde eyabeeranga yekka mu ddungu, Athanasius gwe yali amanyi yennyini. Kyakola okusinga ekiwandiiko ekirala kyonna okutwala endowooza ey'obumonaki mu Bugwanjuba, era kyatuuka ne mu nnimiro y'e Milan, omusomesa Omuwafirika omuvubuka ayitibwa Augustine gye yawulirira ebyafaayo by'abakungu babiri abaakisoma ne baleka emirimu gyabwe amangu ago — era n'alemwa okukiggya mu mutwe gwe. Eby'amagero ebirimu byogerwa nga waliwo okugaana okutasalako okuwa Antony yennyini ekitiibwa.

q: Lwaki ebbaluwa ye ey'embaga eya 367 nkulu?
a: Buli mwaka omulabirizi w'e Alexandria yawandiikanga ebbaluwa ey'embaga ng'alanga olunaku lwa Pasika. Ey'amakumi asatu mu mwenda, eyaweerezebwa mu 367, erimu olukalala: Enjiri ennya, Ebikolwa, ebbaluwa omusanvu ez'ekkanisa yonna, ebbaluwa ekkumi n'ennya eza Pawulo, n'Okubikkulirwa — ebitabo amakumi abiri mu musanvu eby'Endagaano Empya, era lwe lukalala olusinga obukadde olukyaliwo olwatula ebyo byokka nga tewali birala. "Bino bye nsulo ez'obulokozi," bwe yawandiika; "omuntu yenna aleme kubyongerako kintu kyonna, era omuntu yenna aleme kubiggyako kintu kyonna." Yali tateekawo lukalala lwa bitabo ng'alagira, wabula yali awandiika ekyo ekkanisa kye zaali zituuse okusoma.

Ekigambo ekyo kyakolebwa oluvannyuma so si kigambo kye yayogera, era kya mazima kitundu kyokka. Emirundi mingi yasingibwanga obungi mu nkiiko okutuuka we kitasobokera, era waaliwo ebiseera kumpi buli mulabirizi omukulu nga yali amaze okuteeka omukono ku kintu ye kye yali tayinza kuteekako. Naye mu butuufu teyali yekka: yalina Alexandria, ekyamujeemera; abamonaki, abaamukweka; n'ekibinja ky'abaawandiikiranga naye ekyava mu ddungu ly'e Misiri okutuuka e Rome n'e Rhine, era yabawandiikira bonna obutakoma.

Teyali mukugu wa by'omwoyo eby'ekyama era kumpi teyayogeranga ku by'omunda we. Ky'awa mu kifo ky'ekyo kye kifo ekinywevu: Katonda azze ddala, mu mubiri, w'oli. Ne mu Bulamu bwa Antony, buli kyamagero akiggya ku muntu omutukuvu n'akizza ku Kristo — omuwala awonyezebwa agambibwa nti okutuukirira kw'ekyo "si kwange, nze omuntu omunaku, wabula ... kikolwa ky'Omulokozi." Endowooza eyo ye Athanasius nga bw'ali Antony, era y'ensonga lwaki obulamu bwe bwennyini busomebwa bwe butyo.

Yakomawo eka omulundi ogw'enkomerero mu 366 era n'aba n'emyaka musanvu egy'emirembe, n'afiira mu Alexandria nga 2 Maayi 373, ku kitanda kye, mu kibuga kye, ng'awangadde abafuzi abaamugoba. Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka munaana olukiiko olw'e Constantinople lwamalirawo ekibuuzo mu bigambo ekkanisa bye yeeyogera ne kaakano ku Ssande, nti Omwana wa mubiri gumu ne Kitaawe. Teyawangaala kubiwulira; yali akutte olunyiriri ekiseera ekimala omulala alyoke akuume. Teyeerowoozangako ng'omuzira, wabula ng'omulabirizi ataali wa ddembe kwogera ekyo ekitali kya mazima.
